basic.name: Punish (Q)
basic.description: Step forward dealing 113 damage and Slowing enemies by 60% decaying over 2 seconds.

basic.name: Condemn (W)
basic.description: After 1 second, Johanna pulls nearby enemies toward her, Stunning them for 0.25 seconds and dealing 55 damage. Deals 200% increased damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

basic.name: Shield Glare (E)
basic.description: Deal 59 damage to enemies and Blind them for 1.5 seconds.

basic.name: Choose apprentice: (?)
basic.description: {highlight}Activate to choose an allied hero as an apprentice. If your choosen hero receives the MVP screen you will receive 20% extra XP for that match.{/highlight}.
basic.developerCommentary: This is for some roleplay. It's mentioned specially on her debut video that she's looking for an apprentice.
subtexts: X will be the hero selected
This skill must be used on the beginning of the game expiring after the gates open
You have only 1 charge

heroic.name: Falling Sword (R)
heroic.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

heroic.name: Blessed Shield (R)
heroic.description:
Deal 114 damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

{highlight}NEW ACTIVE - Blessed Throw: Activate to throw a Blessed Shield that bounces off walls up to 6 times. This version does not pass through walls but ricochets off them. Shares cooldown with Blessed Shield.{/highlight}
heroic.developerCommentary: This change is aimed on making Johanna have more WTF Moments...often seem as a boring tank i want to bring the best plus i didn't want to remove the baseline version that goes through wall so she has more flexibility by bringing it to an active
subtexts: Blessed Throw is a new active ability that shares cooldown with Blessed Shield
Maximum bounces: 6
The wall bounce works similarly to <vanilla, abilities, basic, 1, hanzo> or <vanilla, abilities, basic, 2, hogger>
Blessed Throw has the same damage and stun values as the standard Blessed Shield

trait.name: Iron Skin (T)
trait.description: Activate to grant Johanna a Shield that absorbs 810 damage for 4 seconds. While this Shield is active, Johanna is Unstoppable.

1.name: Zealous Glare
1.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 75% more damage.

1.name: Trip Attack
1.description: {highlight}If Shield Glare hits an close enemy Hero, Johanna's next Basic Attack gains 0.5 range and stuns the target for 0.6 seconds, plus 0.15 seconds per additional Hero hit by Shield Glare.{/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: I wanted to bring other ways to perform with Shield Glare, i was looking for both ways to make it more effective at close or long range and i came to that idea.
subtexts: Johanna Shield Glare radius is 12. The close range would be 2.0
The extra stun duration counts for every hit on any range

1.name: Consecration
1.description: {highlight}Shield Glare consecrates the ground increasing allied heroes healing received who stand in the area by 15%. The area lasts 5 seconds{/highlight}
passives: {quest}Quest: Every 5 Regeneration Globes gathered increase the healing received by 5%
1.developerCommentary: After looking a lot at the crusader skill tree for Diablo 3 i kinda liked the idea of giving her more utility skills to the team {/quest}
subtexts: The area will be the exactly same size of the Shield Glare

4.name: Subdue
4.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 80% and the Slow amount does not decay.{quest}Quest:{/quest} Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.{reward}Reward:{/reward} Punish always Slows by 80%.

4.name: Sins Exposed
4.description: Punish reduces healing received by {highlight}30%{/highlight} for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them refresh this duration.
passives: {quest}Quest:{/quest} Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish
{reward}Reward:{/reward} Basic attacks against marked targets grants Johanna 1 stack of 40 physical armor block.
4.developerCommentary: I made this level about Punish and i also like the quest from Subdue and i see it as something that makes Johanna more fun overall

4.name: Laws of Valor
4.description: {highlight}Hitting enemy Heroes with punish marks them. Allied heroes basic attacks against marked heroes grants them 20% attack speed for 2 seconds{/highlight}
passives: {quest}Quest:{/quest} Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish
{reward}Reward:{/reward} Johanna basic attacks against marked heroes also heals 1.25% of maximum health of nearby heroes
4.developerCommentary: I want my Crusader have the possibility for an utility tank similar to how Tyrael works as it's on the core values on the Diablo 3 being a support frontline.
subtexts: Radius will be 6.5 same as Uther Benediction

7.name: Protect the Innocent
7.description: {highlight}Johanna redirects 65% of the damage taken to an allied hero to herself for 2 seconds being unable to act during that time.{/highlight}
7.developerCommentary: I find that skill extremely suitable for the roleplay of a Crusader and besides this skill will be balance through the range of use as it could eazily render an hyper carry immortal.
subtexts: Cooldown: 70 seconds
Range: 4

7.name: Conviction
7.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

7.name: Steed Charge
7.description: Activate to instantly Mount for 3 seconds, unhindered by damage.
passives: {highlight}While unhindered Johanna Mount kills minions on contact instantly.{/highlight}
{highlight}While mounted Johanna restores 1% of her maximum health points per seconds increased to 5% while unhindered.{/highlight}
7.developerCommentary: There's not much to say about it..i just wanted to make a stomping horse.

10.name: Falling Sword
10.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

10.description:
Deal 114 damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

{highlight}NEW ACTIVE - Blessed Throw: Activate to throw a Blessed Shield that bounces off walls up to 6 times. This version does not pass through walls but ricochets off them. Shares cooldown with Blessed Shield.{/highlight}

Maximum bounces: 6
The wall bounce works similarly to <vanilla, abilities, basic, 1, hanzo> or <vanilla, abilities, basic, 2, hogger>
Blessed Throw has the same damage and stun values as the standard Blessed Shield

13.name: Shield Bash
13.description: {highlight}Increase Punish's damage by 50%. If you hit atleast 2 enemy heroes you can reactivate Punish dealing 125 damage and knock back enemy heroes. Increase Punish damage against shields by 300%{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: I wanted to bring somehow the shieldbash without using a direct stun
subtexts: Knockback duration: 0.25 same Dehaka Drag
Knockback speed: 16.5 it's the same as Dehaka Drag

13.name: Holy Fury
13.description: {highlight}Iron Skin can now be used while stunned or silenced. If used that way increases it's shield by 50% and deal 60 damage in area per second while it's active, increase the damage by 100% against shield and summons.{/highlight}

13.name: Blessed Hammer
13.description: Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 74 damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2 seconds.Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

16.name: Vacuum
16.description: {highlight}Create an outer area of Condemn, that area will pull enemy heroes with 200% stronger force and damage{/highlight}
16.developerCommentary: This was the first skill that i wanted to add to Johanna i wanted to make that skill have another interaction that would make it cool
subtexts: The outer radius is 1.0. Current Condemn is 5.0 so it will effectively increase the radius to 6.0
The pull speed is going to be increased from 19 to 57

16.name: Holy Renewal
16.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.

16.name: Divine Fortress
16.description:
{highlight}Reduces all basic attack damage received from the direction you are facing by 40% returning the damage to the attacker.{/highlight}

{highlight}While Iron Skin is active, the damage returned is increased to 60%.{/highlight}
16.developerCommentary: Crusaders are strongly related to thorns and I liked the Holy Hold concept so I leveled it up.
subtexts: The damage is after physical armor blocks

20.name: Heaven's Fury
20.description: Falling Sword rains down holy bolts, dealing 50 damage to enemies, healing allied Heroes for 68, and reducing its cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

20.name: Radiating Faith
20.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blessed Shield by 2. Its Stun duration is increased to 1.75 seconds and all targets hit are Stunned for the maximum duration.

20.name: Indestructible
20.description: {highlight}Upon taking fatal damage, Johanna gains a Shield equal to her maximum Health for 4 seconds. Can be activated to grant nearby allied heroes a shield equal to 25% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds setting the cooldown to 60 seconds. Hitting Heroes with Shield Glare reduces the cooldown of this ability by 8 seconds.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: The objective was to make both Indestructible and Akarat's Champion one talent but on a flexible way.

20.name: Akarat's Champion
20.description: {highlight}Activate to increase Johanna attack speed by 60% for 6 seconds.{/highlight}
passives: {highlight}Johanna Basic attacks now cleave they also reduce Johanna's Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds on every enemy hit.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: Similar to Bruiseradin i want to make Bruiserhanna a commom thing
subtexts: Same cleave as Malthael of 3.25 radius

developerCommentary: Current Johanna is strong and solid. I am changing her for increased build variety specially on <vanilla, abilities, basic, 2> and bringing some skill expression talents to her.
